paper_id: Benchmarking of DL Libraries and Models on Mobile Devices
title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Deep Learning Libraries on Mobile Devices
motivation: 现有benchmark聚焦硬件或算法，DL库性能被忽视；移动生态严重碎片化导致开发者难以选择
problem_framing: 在多样模型和硬件上系统测量6个DL库的性能差异与根源
key_insight: DL软件的影响可能压倒算法设计和硬件容量的优化效果
evaluation_criteria: 推理延迟、算子级性能、冷启动开销、库间性能差距
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: INT8量化加速仅0.8×-3.0×远低于理论4×；GPU在某些模型上比CPU更慢
evidence_for_taste: up to 62,806× gap between vanilla and fine-tuned
INT8-based quantization only brings 0.8×–3.0× inference speedup
GPU even runs slower than CPU (up to 2.3×)
some commits incur significant performance degradation
thinking_moves: 通过系统化benchmark揭示软件栈被忽视的性能作用
从碎片化现象反推底层实现差异（算子级）
用oracle组合实验量化潜在优化空间
冷启动问题揭示memory preparation被单线程瓶颈拖累
